title: The Old Watchtower's free 'get your bearings' said 'the fens spread east, toward Hollowbrook,' but every NPC (the reeve, the innkeep) names that same eastward hold 'Fenmarch,' with Hollowbrook described elsewhere as a separate hold lying beyond Fenmarch — the bearing skips the nearer, correctly-named landmark for a farther one.
where: Old Watchtower / get your bearings from the parapet
